clue.text: British band's transport

parts.note: a ring is a circular band, as worn on a finger

explanation.surface: A British pop group's tour bus or van.
explanation.definitionFit: To transport something somewhere is to carry or convey it there, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Consecrated garden area containing fewer

indicators.note: one piece holds the other, so the word for fewer sits inside the garden word

parts.note: a bed is a patch of a garden for plants
less is an informal equivalent of fewer

explanation.surface: A holy plot of garden ground that somehow holds a smaller number.
explanation.definitionFit: Something consecrated has been made holy by a religious rite, which is one sense of the synonym.

clue.text: One to copy Renoir, say

definitions.meaning: a mimic who copies the voices and mannerisms of celebrities
Renoir was a leading painter of the French ... movement

explanation.surface: Someone who imitates the French painter Renoir.
explanation.definitionFit: A stage mimic and a painter of the Monet–Renoir school share the same title.

clue.text: Dry enough exercising dog

indicators.note: exercising suggests working the letters about, as a body is put through movements

explanation.surface: Walking a dog in weather that is dry enough for it.
explanation.definitionFit: A slim, fast breed of hound used in racing is a kind of dog.

clue.text: Advantage of busy worker possessing new suit

indicators.note: one piece holds the other, so the insect word has the new letter inside it

parts.note: a bee is the proverbial busy worker
to suit someone is to fit them

explanation.surface: The perks enjoyed by a hard-working employee who owns a fresh suit.
explanation.definitionFit: An advantage or perk is a good thing gained, the noun synonym.

clue.text: Boris unsettled about temperature in restaurant

indicators.note: about means going around, so the rearranged name surrounds the abbreviation
unsettled means the letters of the name are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: Boris is uneasy about how hot it is in a restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unsettled' rearranges BORIS to BISRO, and 'about' wraps that round T.
explanation.definitionFit: A bistro is a small, informal eating place, a type of restaurant.

clue.text: Down in a pillow? Some

indicators.note: some of the words is a portion of their letters, taken from within the run

explanation.surface: Asking whether a pillow contains some feathers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Down' looks like feathers, fitting the pillow, but it means the soft raised fibres on cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: The soft fluffy surface on velvet or felt is called its pile, a sense close to fine fluff.

clue.text: Sherry, for instance, wife tried — fino, possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters may form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A wife sampled a fino, perhaps, as an example of sherry.
explanation.walkthrough: Fino is a pale dry sherry, which helps the picture but here is only letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherry is one example of a wine strengthened with added brandy, like port or madeira.

clue.text: Article, new at that time

parts.note: the is the definite article in grammar

explanation.surface: A news item was fresh back in those days.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb refers to a moment in the past or future, meaning on that occasion.

clue.text: Former partner, smooth and articulate

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
to press clothes is to smooth them with an iron

explanation.surface: A description of an ex who is suave and well-spoken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articulate' reads as an adjective but is the verb, to put into words.
explanation.definitionFit: To articulate feelings is to voice or put them into words, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Son splitting total prize money

indicators.note: splitting means breaking into the other word, so the single letter goes inside it

parts.note: pure can mean total, as in pure nonsense

explanation.surface: A son has to share the whole of the winnings.
explanation.definitionFit: The sum offered as a prize in boxing or racing is called by this name.

clue.text: Watch over most of scouts making a traditional dish

parts.note: to shepherd is to guide and look after, as with a flock

indicators.note: most of means all the letters except the last are used

parts.note: spies are scouts sent to gather intelligence

explanation.surface: Supervising nearly all the Scout troop while they cook a classic meal.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a British dish of minced lamb topped with mashed potato, baked in the oven.

clue.text: Insist on ordering it, plus tea

indicators.note: ordering means arranging the letters into a fresh sequence

explanation.surface: Someone demands to order a drink along with a cup of tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ordering' looks like asking for something in a café; it rearranges the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To insist on a term in a contract is to demand or specify it as a condition.

clue.text: Briefly debate field event

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to discuss is to debate a topic

explanation.surface: A quick argument about one of the athletics competitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Throwing the heavy disc is an athletics field event, as opposed to a track race.

clue.text: Mounted apparatus to restrict noise

indicators.note: to restrict is to hem in, so the word for equipment encloses the noise word

parts.note: a rig is a piece of equipment or apparatus, as in a drilling rig
din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: Equipment has been installed to limit the racket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mounted' suggests fixed in place; here it means on horseback.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on horseback is said to be riding, so the participle fits a rider who is mounted.

clue.text: Good skill, guys admitted, producing an item of clothing

indicators.note: admitted means let in, so the word for chaps goes inside the skill word

parts.note: art is a skill, as in the art of conversation
men are guys

explanation.surface: A clever craftsman let some fellows in to make a piece of clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Any single piece of apparel, such as a coat or dress, is so called.

clue.text: Rubbish written about head of hunting party

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the rubbish word goes round the single letter

parts.note: trash is rubbish

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Nonsense has been published about the man leading a hunt party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'written' is a link word. 'party' is the definition: in British slang a thrash is a lively party.
explanation.definitionFit: In British informal speech a big lively celebration is called by this name.

clue.text: Ignore unfriendly bear

parts.note: cold means unfriendly or distant in manner
to shoulder a burden is to bear it

explanation.surface: Steer clear of a hostile bear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bear' looks like the animal but is the verb, to carry.
explanation.definitionFit: To snub someone deliberately is an idiom meaning to treat them with pointed neglect.

clue.text: Starts to hear about lad's onyx ring

indicators.note: the starts of the words are their opening letters, taken in order

explanation.surface: Getting the gist of news about a boy's gemstone ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A circle of light around a saint's head or the moon is a luminous ring.

clue.text: A schoolgirl, perhaps wrong

parts.note: a miss is a young girl, of whom a schoolgirl is an example

explanation.surface: A schoolgirl may be mistaken.
explanation.definitionFit: Something amiss is out of order or not right, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: Leave out short piece of winter sports equipment

indicators.note: short means cut off before the end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: to skip something is to leave it out

explanation.surface: Omitting a small bit of the kit used for snow sports.
explanation.definitionFit: One of a pair of long runners strapped to boots for gliding over snow.

clue.text: Greed shown by a new vicar, last in brasserie

indicators.note: new means remade, so the letters are rearranged into a fresh order
the last in a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A newly appointed vicar shows his gluttony, last to leave a restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: Avarice is an extreme desire for wealth, one of the seven deadly sins.

clue.text: Very large turkey to begin with, full-flavoured bird

parts.note: OS is short for outsize, a clothing size for very large

indicators.note: to begin with means only the opening letter of the word is taken

parts.note: rich food is full-flavoured

explanation.surface: A huge turkey makes, at first, a tasty bird for dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turkey' and 'bird' suggest one fowl, but the definition is a different bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest living flightless bird, native to Africa, is named here.

clue.text: Incident in flat ending in arrest

parts.note: even means flat or level

indicators.note: the ending in a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Something happened at an apartment that ended with someone being arrested.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flat' suggests an apartment but means level.
explanation.definitionFit: An incident is an occurrence or happening, a noun synonym.
